name: Growington Ventures India Limited
about: Growington Ventures India Limited engages in the import and exporting of fruits in India. It offers apples, oranges, pears, plums and stone fruits, kiwis, red globe grapes, nectarines, dates, dragon fruits, bananas, citrus fruits, mangosteen, rambutans, cherries, avocados, tamarinds, peaches, green apples, blueberries, longan, grape fruit, mandarins, mangoes, and exotic tropical fruits. The company was formerly known as VMV Holidays Limited and changed its name to Growington Ventures India Limited in October 2021. Growington Ventures India Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
